mapper.select: SELECT sr.*, u.email as user_email, o.order_no FROM support_requests sr LEFT JOIN users u ON sr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON sr.order_id = o.id WHERE sr.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM support_requests WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_requests (order_id, user_id, type, subject, message, priority, contact_email) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{subject}, #{message}, #{priority}, #{contactEmail})
mapper.update: UPDATE support_requests SET status = #{status}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE support_requests SET admin_reply = #{adminReply}, replied_by = #{repliedBy}, replied_at = #{repliedAt}, status = 'IN_PROGRESS', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE support_requests SET ai_suggested_reply = #{aiSuggestedReply}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_requests WHERE status = #{status}
